title: Welcome to Pi mx Desktop
intro: One choice first: which pi the agent runs on. You can change this later in Settings → Runtime.
globalDesc: Shares the pi you already use in a terminal: same version, same extensions and skills. Needs node/npm; if pi is missing we install it.
builtinTitle: Use the built-in pi (works out of the box)
builtinDesc: Ships with the app, no node/npm needed, upgrades with the app — but it is separate from the terminal copy.
envIntro: These three decide whether the global runtime works. Missing node/npm must be installed; a missing pi we install in one click.
modelTitle: One last step: connect a model
modelIntro: Sign in with an existing subscription or API key to start chatting right away, or skip and configure it later in Settings.
modelEmpty: No built-in auth providers found right now. You can add a custom provider or relay in Settings.
modelReady: Model connected — you are ready to chat!
